sections.title: Unit 12: Ingenuity, Design & Practical Problem-Solving
body: From nineteenth-century mining engineering and dynamo prototypes to the Rubik's Cube and contemporary software architecture, Hungarian technical culture prizes elegant, practical problem-solving. In formal engineering, academic, and project-design registers, Hungarian condenses whole relative clauses of obligation ('the problem that must be solved', 'the safety standard that should be followed') into a single prenominal participle ending in -andó/-endő.

In this unit, you will master the formation and syntax of the obligatory participle (-andó/-endő), high-register postpositions of means and mediation (révén, útján, segítségével, által), purposive specifications (céljából, érdekében, végett), and how to pitch a technical innovation in polished B2 Hungarian.
